chunks.section: Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting · 5 Position the Gate Opener on the Gate
chunks.question: Position the Gate Opener on the Gate
chunks.embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting 5 Position the Gate Opener on the Gate Title:Position the Gate Opener on the Gate Pull-to-Open 拉式开门 拉开门 内开 inward opening 非推开门 Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting: STEP 5 Position the Gate Opener on the Gate. Clamp the gate opener arm along with the post bracket assembly to the marked position on the gate post. Make sure that the gate opener arm is fully retracted and the gate is fully opened to the desired position. Put a level on the arm, then use a C-clamp to secure the gate bracket onto the gate when the arm is level.
chunks.content_en:
Clamp the gate opener arm along with the post bracket assembly to the marked position on the gate post.
Make sure that the gate opener arm is fully retracted and the gate is fully opened to the desired position.
Put a level on the arm, then use a C-clamp to secure the gate bracket onto the gate when the arm is level.

chunks.embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting 6 Test Gate Travel and Mark the Brackets Mounting Locations Title:Test Gate Travel and Mark the Brackets Mounting Locations Pull-to-Open 拉式开门 拉开门 内开 inward opening 非推开门 Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting STEP 6 Test Gate Travel and Mark the Brackets Mounting Locations, gate bracket position, minimum clearance 2.5cm (1"), gate opener bind, pull-to-open bracket, post bracket assembly, mounting locations, gate opening angle, YouTube video. 手动打开和关闭门，以确保门支架位置正确。 确保门与开门器之间至少有2.5厘米（1英寸）的间隙。 确保开门器不会卡在拉开式支架上。 如果间隙小于2.5厘米（1英寸），或者开门器与拉开式支架卡住，请旋转拉开式支架和/或移动立柱支架组件。 标记支架安装位置的中心。 注意：此步骤对于确定开门器臂的位置和开门角度非常重要。强烈建议观看我们的YouTube分步安装视频以获取指导。
chunks.content_zh:
手动打开和关闭门，以确保门支架位置正确。
确保门与开门器之间至少有2.5厘米（1英寸）的间隙。
确保开门器不会卡在拉开式支架上。
如果间隙小于2.5厘米（1英寸），或者开门器与拉开式支架卡住，请旋转拉开式支架和/或移动立柱支架组件。

chunks.content_en:
Manually open and close the gate to ensure that the gate bracket position is correct.
Ensure that there is a minimum clearance of 2.5cm (1") between the gate and the opener.
Make sure that the gate opener does not bind against the pull-to-open bracket.
If the clearance is less than 2.5cm (1"), or if the gate opener and the pull-to-open bracket are binding, rotate the pull-to-open bracket and/or move the post bracket assembly.
Mark the center of the mounting locations for the brackets.
NOTE: This step is very important for determining the position of the gate opener arm and the gate opening angle. It is highly recommended to watch our step-by-step installation video on YouTube for guidance.

chunks.embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Terminal Function of the Control Board Title:Terminal Function of the Control Board 端子功能表 Terminal Function Control Board 接线端子对照表 PHOTO Photo Eye Photocell Infrared Sensor 光电传感器 常闭 NC BAT +BAT- Battery Backup Battery 电池输入 系统供电 电源输入 GND COM OPSW EDGE O/S/C ADAPTER LAMP MOTOR DLMT ULMT +24 +LOCK- Terminal Function of the Control Board 控制板接线端子功能 +24 PHOTO GND O/S/C COM OPSW EDGE LOCK BAT ADAPTER LAMP MOTOR DLMT ULMT 控制板端子功能对照表：①+24、③GND 端子输出24VDC电压为光电传感器供电；②PHOTO、③GND 接收光电传感器信号，常闭(NC)输入；④O/S/C、⑤COM 通过常开干接点信号控制大门循环开/停/关/停，常接推杆开关、有线密码器、外接收器；⑥OPSW、⑤COM 接收车辆检测器常开输出的开门信号；⑦EDGE、⑧GND 接收防夹边缘传感器常开信号；⑨⑩+LOCK- 输出接大门电锁正负极，要求
chunks.content_zh: 控制板端子功能对照表：①+24、③GND 端子输出24VDC电压为光电传感器供电；②PHOTO、③GND 接收光电传感器信号，常闭(NC)输入；④O/S/C、⑤COM 通过常开干接点信号控制大门循环开/停/关/停，常接推杆开关、有线密码器、外接收器；⑥OPSW、⑤COM 接收车辆检测器常开输出的开门信号；⑦EDGE、⑧GND 接收防夹边缘传感器常开信号；⑨⑩+LOCK- 输出接大门电锁正负极，要求失电闭锁型、额定24VDC、额定电流<3A；⑪⑫+BAT- 输入接24VDC电池或电源正负极，为整个系统供电；⑬⑭ADAPTER 输入接适配器为电池充电，也可接36VDC或24VAC电源；⑮⑯+LAMP- 输出接警示灯正负极，要求额定24VDC、额定电流<1A；⑰⑱+MOTOR- 接机械臂电机红黑线；⑲DLMT、⑳COM、㉑ULMT 接限位开关，近端限位接DLMT和COM，远端限位接ULMT和COM。
chunks.content_en: Terminal Function table: (1)+24 (3)GND - Provide 24VDC to power photocell sensors. (2)PHOTO (3)GND - Receive photocell NC signal. (4)O/S/C (5)COM - Open/stop/close/stop cycling via NO dry contact. (6)OPSW (5)COM - Vehicle sensor NO opening signal. (7)EDGE (8)GND - Edge sensor NO. (9)(10)+LOCK- - Electric lock fail-secure 24VDC <3A. (11)(12)+BAT- - 24VDC battery/power input. (13)(14)ADAPTER - Adapter charging; 36VDC or 24VAC. (15)(16)+LAMP- - Warning light 24VDC <1A. (17)(18)+MOTOR- - Motor red/black wires. (19)DLMT (20)COM (21)ULMT - Limit switches; near-end DLMT/COM, far-end ULMT/COM.

Tighten screws. 1. 将线束穿过电缆接头插入控制箱。 2. 将红色电线连接到端子 ⑰ “+MOTOR1”，将黑色电线连接到端子 ⑱ “MOTOR1-”，将蓝色电线连接到端子 ⑲ “DLMT”，将绿色电线连接到端子 ⑳ “COM”，将黄色电线连接到端子 ㉑ “ULMT”。 3. 拧紧每个螺钉，以防电线松动脱落。 1. Insert the wire harness through the cable gland into the control box. 2. Connect the red wire into terminal ⑰ “+MOTOR1”, the black wire into termin
chunks.content_zh:
1. 将线束穿过电缆接头插入控制箱。
2. 将红色电线连接到端子 ⑰ “+MOTOR1”，将黑色电线连接到端子 ⑱ “MOTOR1-”，将蓝色电线连接到端子 ⑲ “DLMT”，将绿色电线连接到端子 ⑳ “COM”，将黄色电线连接到端子 ㉑ “ULMT”。
3. 拧紧每个螺钉，以防电线松动脱落。
chunks.content_en:
1. Insert the wire harness through the cable gland into the control box.
2. Connect the red wire into terminal ⑰ “+MOTOR1”, the black wire into terminal ⑱ “MOTOR1-”, the blue wire into terminal ⑲ “DLMT”, the green wire into terminal ⑳ “COM”, and the yellow wire into terminal ㉑ “ULMT”.
3. Tighten each of the screws so that the wires do not come loose and fall out.

chunks.content_en: INSTALLER AND END USER RESPONSIBILITY: An experienced installer should perform the installation. Improper installation may result in property damage, severe injury or death. The gate opener is only part of the entire gate operating system, and it is the responsibility of the installer and end user to ensure that the total system is safe for its intended use.

chunks.content_en: INSTALL SAFETY SENSOR: The gate opener is designed to stop and reverse the gate when the gate comes in contact with an obstruction. It is highly recommended to install a photocell sensor in the following situations for safety: if you have children or pets at your property, the gate opener auto close function is set to ON, the gate opener stall force is set to the maximum, a vehicle exit sensor is installed, or other gate control devices are used.

chunks.section: Important Safety Information · During Installation - Gate Control Accessories Placement
chunks.question: During Installation - Gate Control Accessories Placement
chunks.embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Important Safety Information During Installation - Gate Control Accessories Placement Title:During Installation - Gate Control Accessories Placement 安全警示 Safety Warning 注意事项 非接线教程 非端子功能表 Installation, Gate Control Accessories, Placement, Safety Distance, 1.5 meters, 5 feet, Moving Parts, Security Feature, Unauthorized Use
chunks.content_en: GATE CONTROL ACCESSORIES PLACEMENT: Gate control accessories intended for user activation must be located at least 1.5 meters (5') away from any moving part of the gate and where the user is prevented from reaching over, under, around or through the gate to operate the controls. Outdoor or easily accessible controls shall have a security feature to prevent unauthorized use.

images.caption: Recommended placement for gate control accessories, showing a 1.5m (5') safety distance from moving parts and restricted access areas.

chunks.section: Important Safety Information · After Installation - Warning Signs
chunks.question: After Installation - Warning Signs
chunks.embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Important Safety Information After Installation - Warning Signs Title:After Installation - Warning Signs 安全警示 Safety Warning 注意事项 非接线教程 非端子功能表 After Installation, Warning Signs, Gate Safety, Automatic Gate Opener, Injury, Death, Customer Support
chunks.content_en: WARNING SIGNS: Attach the provided warning signs to both sides of the gate to alert the public about the automatic gate opener system. If your signs are damaged, please reach out to TOPENS Customer Support for replacements.

images.caption: Illustration showing a gate with a warning sign installed, indicating 'Outside Property' and 'Inside Property' for proper placement.

Detail of the warning sign text: 'Moving Gate Can Cause Serious Injury Or Death'. Points include 'Persons are to keep clear!', 'The gate is able to cycle at any time.', 'Do not let children operate the gate or play in the gate area.', and 'This entrance is for vehicles only. Pedestrians must use separate entrance.'

chunks.section: Important Safety Information · After Installation - Away from Moving Gates
chunks.question: After Installation - Away from Moving Gates
chunks.embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Important Safety Information After Installation - Away from Moving Gates Title:After Installation - Away from Moving Gates 安全警示 Safety Warning 注意事项 非接线教程 非端子功能表 After Installation, Moving Gates, Children, Pets, Livestock, Danger, Safety
chunks.content_en: AWAY FROM MOVING GATES: Keep children, pets and livestock away from the gate opener system as moving gates can be dangerous.

chunks.section: Important Safety Information · After Installation - Secure Gate Control Accessories
chunks.question: After Installation - Secure Gate Control Accessories
chunks.embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Important Safety Information After Installation - Secure Gate Control Accessories Title:After Installation - Secure Gate Control Accessories 安全警示 Safety Warning 注意事项 非接线教程 非端子功能表 After Installation, Gate Control Accessories, Secure, Children, Remote Transmitters, Keypads, Push Buttons, Storage, Safety
chunks.content_en: SECURE GATE CONTROL ACCESSORIES: Prevent children from operating gate controls by keeping remote transmitters, keypads, and push buttons out of their reach. Store in a secure area when not in use.

chunks.section: Connection of Power Supply · WARNING
chunks.question: WARNING
chunks.embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Connection of Power Supply WARNING Title:WARNING Connection of Power Supply 电源接线 接线步骤 供电连接 Power Mode 电源模式 非安全警示页 WARNING 安全 连接 安装 触电 电工 浪涌保护器 TS24-U 接线必须由专业电工完成，以避免受伤、触电或死亡的风险。在所有安装完成之前，切勿将开门器连接到电源插座。建议使用额定电流为 5A 的浪涌保护器与 TS24-U 适配器或电源（单独出售）。如果电源插座位于室外，请使用防风雨盖进行保护。
chunks.content_zh: 接线必须由专业电工完成，以避免受伤、触电或死亡的风险。在所有安装完成之前，切勿将开门器连接到电源插座。建议使用额定电流为 5A 的浪涌保护器与 TS24-U 适配器或电源（单独出售）。如果电源插座位于室外，请使用防风雨盖进行保护。
chunks.content_en: A professional electrician is required for wire connection to avoid the risk of injury, electric shock, or death. NEVER connect the gate opener to the electrical outlet before all the installations have been done. It is recommended to use a surge protector with a rated current of 5A with the TS24-U adapter or power supply (sold separately). Protect the electrical outlet with a weatherproof cover if it is located outdoors.

chunks.section: Connection of Power Supply · 1 Power Mode 1: By the Adapter and Batteries
chunks.question: Power Mode 1: By the Adapter and Batteries
chunks.embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Connection of Power Supply 1 Power Mode 1: By the Adapter and Batteries Title:Power Mode 1: By the Adapter and Batteries Connection of Power Supply 电源接线 接线步骤 供电连接 Power Mode 电源模式 非安全警示页 Power Mode 1, 适配器, 电池, TS24-U, ADAPTER, +BAT-, 24VDC 将 TS24-U 适配器连接到控制板的“ADAPTER”端子，不分线的极性。串联连接两节 12VDC 电池以实现 24VDC（不含电池）。将电池连接到控制板的“+BAT-”端子。将 TS24-U 适配器插入电源插座。
chunks.content_zh: 将 TS24-U 适配器连接到控制板的“ADAPTER”端子，不分线的极性。串联连接两节 12VDC 电池以实现 24VDC（不含电池）。将电池连接到控制板的“+BAT-”端子。将 TS24-U 适配器插入电源插座。
chunks.content_en: Connect the TS24-U adapter to the "ADAPTER" terminals of the control board, regardless of the polarity of the wires. Connect two 12VDC batteries in series to achieve 24VDC (batteries not included). Connect the batteries to the "+BAT-" terminals of the control board. Plug the TS24-U adapter into an electrical outlet.

images.caption: Connection diagram for Power Mode 1 using adapter and batteries.

chunks.section: Connection of Power Supply · IMPORTANT NOTES (Power Mode 1)
chunks.question: IMPORTANT NOTES (Power Mode 1)
chunks.embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Connection of Power Supply IMPORTANT NOTES (Power Mode 1) Title:IMPORTANT NOTES (Power Mode 1) Connection of Power Supply 电源接线 接线步骤 供电连接 Power Mode 电源模式 非安全警示页 重要注意事项, 适配器, 电池充电, 电缆延长, 24VDC 7Ah 电池 适配器仅用于给电池充电。适配器输出电缆的长度为 1.2m (4ft.)。为了延长电缆，电缆应至少为 2C x 1.3 mm² (16AWG)。如果控制板与适配器之间的距离超过 100m (330ft.)，电缆应至少为 2C x 2 mm² (14AWG)。最大延长距离为 300m (1000ft.)。如果开门器由电池供电并利用交流电充电，则需要至少一个 24VDC 7Ah 汽车/船用型电池。
chunks.content_zh: 适配器仅用于给电池充电。适配器输出电缆的长度为 1.2m (4ft.)。为了延长电缆，电缆应至少为 2C x 1.3 mm² (16AWG)。如果控制板与适配器之间的距离超过 100m (330ft.)，电缆应至少为 2C x 2 mm² (14AWG)。最大延长距离为 300m (1000ft.)。如果开门器由电池供电并利用交流电充电，则需要至少一个 24VDC 7Ah 汽车/船用型电池。
chunks.content_en: The adapter is ONLY used to charge the battery. The length of the adapter output cable is 1.2m (4ft.). To extend the cable, the cable should be at least 2C x 1.3 mm² (16AWG). If the distance between the control board and the adapter is more than 100m (330ft.), the cable should be at least 2C x 2 mm² (14AWG). The maximum extension distance is 300m (1000ft.). If the gate opener is powered by batteries and utilizes AC electricity for charging, a minimum of a 24VDC 7Ah automotive / marine type battery is required.

chunks.section: Connection of Power Supply · 2 Power Mode 2: Use AC Electricity Only
chunks.question: Power Mode 2: Use AC Electricity Only
chunks.embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Connection of Power Supply 2 Power Mode 2: Use AC Electricity Only Title:Power Mode 2: Use AC Electricity Only Connection of Power Supply 电源接线 接线步骤 供电连接 Power Mode 电源模式 非安全警示页 Power Mode 2, 交流电, DPS180-U, +BAT- 将 DPS180-U AC-DC 电源（单独出售）输出线上的公端子连接到连接到控制板“+BAT-”端子的电源输入线的母端子。将 DPS180-U 电源线插入电源插座。
chunks.content_zh: 将 DPS180-U AC-DC 电源（单独出售）输出线上的公端子连接到连接到控制板“+BAT-”端子的电源输入线的母端子。将 DPS180-U 电源线插入电源插座。
chunks.content_en: Connect the male terminals from the output wires of the DPS180-U AC-DC power supply (sold separately) to the female terminals of the power input wires connected to the "+BAT-" terminals of the control board. Plug the DPS180-U power cord into an electrical outlet.

images.caption: Connection diagram for Power Mode 2 using AC electricity only.

chunks.section: Connection of Power Supply · IMPORTANT NOTE (Power Mode 2)
chunks.question: IMPORTANT NOTE (Power Mode 2)
chunks.embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Connection of Power Supply IMPORTANT NOTE (Power Mode 2) Title:IMPORTANT NOTE (Power Mode 2) Connection of Power Supply 电源接线 接线步骤 供电连接 Power Mode 电源模式 非安全警示页 重要注意事项, DPS180-U, 电池, 太阳能电池板, 连接 DPS180-U 电源不能连接电池或太阳能电池板。
chunks.content_zh: DPS180-U 电源不能连接电池或太阳能电池板。
chunks.content_en: The DPS180-U power supply can NOT connect with batteries or solar panels.

chunks.section: Before You Begin
chunks.question: Before You Begin
chunks.content_en: Before You Begin

chunks.section: Before You Begin · Check the Gate
chunks.question: Check the Gate
chunks.embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Before You Begin Check the Gate Title:Check the Gate Before You Begin 安装前准备 工具清单 非端子接线 非控制板端子表 Before You Begin - Check the Gate: Ensure gate is plumb, level, swings freely, mounted to stable post, repair damaged hardware.
chunks.content_en: Ensure that the gate is plumb, level, and swings freely on its hinges without binding or dragging on the ground. The gate should be mounted to a very stable post or column that is secured in the ground with concrete. Repair or replace all worn or damaged gate hardware prior to installation.

chunks.section: Before You Begin · Tools Needed
chunks.question: Tools Needed
chunks.embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Before You Begin Tools Needed Title:Tools Needed Before You Begin 安装前准备 工具清单 非端子接线 非控制板端子表 Before You Begin - Tools Needed: Power Drill, Wire Strippers, Level, Phillips Screwdriver, Tape Measure, C-Clamps, Hacksaw, Bolt Cutters, Open End Wrenches.
chunks.content_en: Tools Needed: Power Drill, Wire Strippers, Level, Phillips Screwdriver, Tape Measure, C-Clamps - small, medium, and large, Hacksaw or Heavy Duty Bolt Cutters, Open End Wrenches - 14# &17# or Adjustable Wrenches.

chunks.section: Before You Begin · Items Not Included but May Needed
chunks.question: Items Not Included but May Needed
chunks.embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Before You Begin Items Not Included but May Needed Title:Items Not Included but May Needed Before You Begin 安装前准备 工具清单 非端子接线 非控制板端子表 Before You Begin - Items Not Included but May Needed: Battery, Solar Panel, PVC Conduit, Connection Cable, Weatherproof Cover, Surge Protector.
chunks.content_en: Items Not Included but May Needed: Battery and Solar Panel: If you choose to use batteries and solar panels as main power source, you'll require 24V 12Ah battery (NOT included). Marine / automotive type battery or lead acid / GEL / AGM / flooded (deep cycle battery) batteries are supported, EXCEPT for lithium-ion battery. The batteries should be waterproof, or they should be placed in waterproof housing. Two 10W solar panels and one solar charge controller are included in A3S/A5S/A8S. If additional solar panel is needed, TOPENS solar panel kit is available for separate purchase. PVC Conduit: Required to protect the cable connecting TC102 infrared photocell sensor to the control board. Connection Cable: Connection cable may be required for power supply connection and wired accessories installation. Refer to the Connection of Power Supply and Connection of Accessories sections in this manual to purchase the correct cable. Weatherproof Cover: Use a weatherproof cover to protect the electrical outlet if it is located outdoors. Surge Protector: A surge protector with a rated current of 5A is recommended to use with the TS24-U adapter or power supply (sold separately).

chunks.section: Before You Begin · Install Electric Gate Lock
chunks.question: Install Electric Gate Lock
chunks.embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Before You Begin Install Electric Gate Lock Title:Install Electric Gate Lock Before You Begin 安装前准备 工具清单 非端子接线 非控制板端子表 Before You Begin - Install Electric Gate Lock: Recommended for windy areas to secure gate and prevent damage.
chunks.content_en: In windy areas, it is crucial to use an electric gate lock to ensure the gate remains securely closed and to prevent damage or malfunction caused by strong winds.

chunks.content_en: It is highly recommended to install a photocell sensor in the following situations for safety: if you have children or pets at your property, the gate opener auto close function is set to ON, the gate opener stall force is set to the maximum, a vehicle exit sensor is installed, or other gate control devices are used.

chunks.section: Before You Begin · Additional Hardware to Enhance Post Bracket Stability
chunks.question: Additional Hardware to Enhance Post Bracket Stability
chunks.embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Before You Begin Additional Hardware to Enhance Post Bracket Stability Title:Additional Hardware to Enhance Post Bracket Stability Before You Begin 安装前准备 工具清单 非端子接线 非控制板端子表 Before You Begin - Additional Hardware to Enhance Post Bracket Stability. Bolts for wooden post, metal plate/washer for stability, expansion bolts for concrete post. Post width under 15cm (6 inches). 确保用于将柱支架连接到木柱的螺栓足够长，能够穿过整个柱子。 在螺栓和木柱之间添加金属板或更大的垫圈，以提高支架的稳定性。 对于混凝土柱，请使用膨胀螺栓牢固地安装支架。 如果柱子的宽度或直径小于15厘米（6英寸），则应使用金属柱或浇筑在水泥中。
chunks.content_zh:
确保用于将柱支架连接到木柱的螺栓足够长，能够穿过整个柱子。
在螺栓和木柱之间添加金属板或更大的垫圈，以提高支架的稳定性。
对于混凝土柱，请使用膨胀螺栓牢固地安装支架。
如果柱子的宽度或直径小于15厘米（6英寸），则应使用金属柱或浇筑在水泥中。
chunks.content_en:
Ensure that the bolts to attach post bracket to wooden post are long enough to pass through the entire post.
Add metal plate or larger washer between the bolt and the wooden post to improve bracket stability.
For concrete post, use expansion bolts to securely mount the bracket.
If the post’s width or diameter is under 15cm (6"), it should be either metal or set in cement.

images.caption: Diagram showing how to attach the post bracket to a wooden post using metal plates/washers and to a concrete post using expansion bolts. Components include Wooden Post, Metal Plate or Larger Washer (NOT Incl.), Post Bracket, Expansion Bolts (NOT Incl.), and Concrete Post.

chunks.content_en:
Each gate is unique and the following steps outline common installation process.
Please ensure that the PULL/PUSH TO OPEN setting on the control board matches the installation type.

Push-to-Open Installation Starts from Page 13

chunks.section: Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting
chunks.question: Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting
chunks.content_zh: 拉式开门门机安装章节（第9页）：STEP 1 装配立柱支架与拉式开门支架；STEP 2 根据尺寸 A、B 确定立柱支架安装位置及最大开门角度。
chunks.content_en: Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting (page 9): STEP 1 assemble post bracket and pull-to-open bracket; STEP 2 determine post bracket position from dimensions A and B and maximum opening angle.

chunks.section: Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting · STEP 1 Assemble the Post Bracket and the Pull-to-Open Bracket
chunks.question: Assemble the Post Bracket and the Pull-to-Open Bracket
chunks.embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting STEP 1 Assemble the Post Bracket and the Pull-to-Open Bracket Title:Assemble the Post Bracket and the Pull-to-Open Bracket Pull-to-Open 拉式开门 拉开门 内开 inward opening 非推开门 Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting STEP 1 Assemble the Post Bracket and Pull-to-Open Bracket 立柱支架 拉式开门支架 装配 将螺栓穿过立柱支架和拉式开门支架上的孔，用垫片和螺母固定，如图所示。注意不要将螺母拧得过紧，因为立柱支架后续可能还需要调整位置。
chunks.content_zh: 将螺栓穿过立柱支架和拉式开门支架上的孔，用垫片和螺母固定，如图所示。注意不要将螺母拧得过紧，因为立柱支架后续可能还需要调整位置。
chunks.content_en: Insert the bolts through the holes of post bracket and pull-to-open bracket, and fasten with washer and nut as shown. DO NOT over tighten the nut because the post bracket may need to be adjusted later.

images.caption: 立柱支架组件爆炸图：展示 M10×35 螺栓、M8×30 螺栓、立柱支架(Post Bracket)、拉式开门支架(Pull-to-Open Bracket)、Φ10垫片、Φ10锁紧垫片、M10螺母、Φ8垫片、M8螺母的装配顺序与相对位置

chunks.section: Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting · STEP 2 Determine the Position of the Post Bracket Assembly
chunks.question: Determine the Position of the Post Bracket Assembly
chunks.embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting STEP 2 Determine the Position of the Post Bracket Assembly Title:Determine the Position of the Post Bracket Assembly Pull-to-Open 拉式开门 拉开门 内开 inward opening 非推开门 Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting STEP 2 Determine Position Post Bracket Assembly opening angle table A B dimensions 开门角度 16cm 14cm 110 下表列出了根据尺寸A和B确定的大门最大开启角度。例如，若A为16cm(6.3")、B为14cm(5.5")，则大门最大开启角度为110°。测量A和B的尺寸以确定所需的开门角度，然后标记立柱支架的安装位置中心。拉式开门(Pull-to-Open)安装时，大门处于开启位置，且机械臂活动杆应完全缩回。
chunks.content_zh: 下表列出了根据尺寸A和B确定的大门最大开启角度。例如，若A为16cm(6.3")、B为14cm(5.5")，则大门最大开启角度为110°。测量A和B的尺寸以确定所需的开门角度，然后标记立柱支架的安装位置中心。拉式开门(Pull-to-Open)安装时，大门处于开启位置，且机械臂活动杆应完全缩回。
chunks.content_en: The table shows the maximum opening angle of the gate based on the dimensions of A and B. For example, if A is 16cm (6.3") and B is 14cm (5.5"), the maximum opening angle of the gate is 110°. Measure the dimension of A and B to determine the desired gate opening angle, then mark the center of the mounting locations for the post bracket accordingly. Pull-to-Open Installation — Gate in open position with the moving rod fully retracted.

images.caption: 安装示意图：显示立柱支架、拉式开门支架、机械臂在开门位置的相对角度，标注尺寸A(支架到臂的垂直距离)与B(支架安装点水平偏移)及关闭方向箭头
A×B开门角度对照表：行为B值(10cm-28cm)，列为A值(10cm-26cm)，交叉单元格为对应最大开门角度(84°-120°不等)
